product_metadata.title: Red Co. Vintage Water Faucet Valve Handle Wall Hooks - Decorative Distressed Metal Hangers (Set of 3)
features: Vintage inspired wall hooks with charming rustic accent
You can safely hang a variety of items on them, like towels, coats, keys, purses, leashes, umbrellas, and more
Sold as a set of three
Requires 6 screws to install (hardware not included)
description: These hooks are strong and durable. Showcase them together or split them up and use them throughout the house wherever you need to tidy up—in the hallway, bedroom, bathroom, or office. Thanks to the material and design, this wall hook set is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. All-metal construction will withstand daily use and any weather conditions. Give them as a host or housewarming gift. The set makes a lovely present for birthdays, engagements, holidays, anniversaries, and more.
